subject: general
question: The Western Ghats are locally known by which name in Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Sahyadri**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Western Ghats are locally known by different names such as **Sahyadri** in Maharashtra,** ****Nilgiri hills** in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu and **Anaimalai hills**__ and Cardamom hills in Kerala.
 
• Western Ghats, also called Sahyadri, north–south-running range of mountains or hills in western India that forms the crest of the western edge of the Deccan plateau parallel to the Malabar Coast of the Arabian Sea.
 
• There are different local names of Western Ghats: **Sahyadri in Maharashtra**. **Nilgiri hills in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu**. **Anaimalai Hills and Cardamom hills in Kerala**.
 
• The Western Ghats in Karnataka are referred to as **Malnad or the land of hills**. 
 
• They are also called the Sahyadris. Malnad runs parallel to the coastline from North to South. They have steep terrace like slopes in the west and gentle slope to the East.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Nilgiri:**

 
 
• ​Bauxite is also produced in Nilgiris, which is well renowned for its **eucalyptus oil and tea**.
 
• Some visitors come to observe the diverse tribes' ways of life or to visit the tea and vegetable gardens.
 
• A summit in the Nilgiri ranges in height from 6,000 to 8,000 feet (1,800 to 2,400 metres) above sea level, with Doda Betta (8,652 feet [2,637 metres]) being the highest point in Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• **Cardamom**:
 
 
• Cardamom Hills are a group of mountains in** Kerala's southeast** that are a part of the Western Ghats mountain range.
 
• Its **eastern peaks **rise to heights of more than 1,370 metres (4,500 feet) above sea level.
 
• The Cardamom, Anaimalai, and Palani hills converge at the Anaimudi peak.
 
 
 
• **Anaimalai:**
 
 
• ​The Anaimalai Hills, commonly known as the Elephant Mountains, are a mountain range in the Tamil Nadu state of southern India's Western Ghats.
 
• There is a lot of wildlife in the** Anamala/Anaimalai Hills**.
 
• These hills' elephant-friendly parks include Eravikulam National Park, Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary, Idamalayar Reserve Forest, Mankulam Forest Division, Parambikulam Wildlife Sanctuary, and Anamalai Tiger Reserve.
